Analyze the provided log messages and respond ONLY with a JSON object. No markdown, no explanation, no code fences. Only an object starting with "{" and ending with "}" should be returned. Use exactly this format: {"anomaly": true/false, "severity": "low|medium|high|none", "action": "stop_cart|alert_admin|none", "summary": "when an image is attached: Image observation: <visible scene>.
